name: devtask
description: Local persistent task workers for agent-driven development.

scripts.build: npm run build:kernel && npm run build:mission && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/chmod-bin.mjs && cp src/instructions/*.md dist/instructions/ && cp -r src/skills/* dist/skills/
scripts.check: npm run build:kernel && npm run build:mission && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:kernel && npm run test:kernel && npm run build:mission && npm run test:mission && vitest run
